weather.summary: Mostly Sunny then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
weather.blurb: Triple digits again. Water bottle, shade, and an early start.

air.blurb: Clean air today — the heat and the ragweed are what will get you.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply.

pollen.note: Tree 3 · Grass 3 · Weed 4 · Ragweed, Elm, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Ragweed and elm and grasses are heavy today. Windows closed, meds early.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 84,800 megawatts, with 104,800 on hand.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 12 hours and 8 minutes today, and down by 7:27 p.m.
